history: Found as a CRASH. lex() decided what kind of token started at a character with c.isalpha() and c.isdigit(), which are Unicode-aware, then matched ASCII-only regexes and called m.group(0) with no None check: AttributeError, not a refusal, and not one of the five exception types replayc/__main__.py catches, so it reached the user as a traceback from `obsign-replayc check` on a file somebody handed them. The gap was exactly the width of the non-ASCII letters and digits.
note: A non-ASCII letter is refused with a source position, exactly as an emoji always was. The same holds for a non-ASCII DIGIT -- an Arabic-Indic three, a superscript two, a fullwidth one -- which is the harder half.
